# Marketplace presentation TODO tracker

Umbrella: <https://github.com/f5-sales-demo/marketplace/issues/1579>. Tracking-system delivery: <https://github.com/f5-sales-demo/marketplace/issues/1580>. Shared prerequisite: <https://github.com/f5-sales-demo/marketplace/issues/1581>.

This file is canonical. Issues hold discussions and link to IDs; they do not duplicate task checkboxes. This milestone creates tracking and acceptance criteria. Presentation implementation proceeds through the TODOs in later sessions.

## Completion and evidence rules

Statuses: TODO, IN PROGRESS, VERIFIED, BLOCKED. NOT APPLICABLE is permitted only for an unexposed capability, with a reason; missing credentials, services or supported hosts remain BLOCKED. Every task row has stable ID, exact scope, acceptance, evidence, receipt, linked delivery and blocker fields. Input fingerprints invalidate prior acceptance on source/runtime changes.

VERIFIED evidence uses `scenario=...; outcome=...; source=<40-character SHA>; plugin=...; runtime=...; host=...`. Receipt is a sanitized public HTTPS link or `private:<identifier>`. Source/mock tests, green merged PR, immutable artifacts and installed/live acceptance remain separate milestones. Keep customer data, credentials and raw installed captures private; public receipts contain outcomes and provenance only. Preserve prior receipts when reopening a task.

## Source and installed baseline

Starting catalog source: `917143c428206f5876debf727e666d999fb81b80`. Discovery runtime: `23.8.0` (repository-pinned published dependency; synthetic registration discovery). Starting installed runtime: Mac `xcsh/23.6.0`; Ubuntu `xcsh/23.6.0`. Observed 2026-10-18T05:35:35.579769+00:00; installed registry versions establish inventory only, not output acceptance.

Native registrations come from the published runtime installed-plugin loader with synthetic executable availability and denied execution/network; no lifecycle handlers are executed. Both present/absent executable branches are inventoried. Shipped commands, skills, agents and hook declarations are enumerated using marketplace content conventions. Native tools outside src/tools are included. Each source surface lists its origin; content-only plugins have no invented native tool. Runtime lifecycle mode/status is tracked for every plugin; setup only where declared, plus actual event, integration, message, advisory, flag and shortcut registrations.

## Session workflow

At each continuation read this tracker, verify active source and installed versions, run inventory validation, and resume the first unfinished ID in implementation order. Preserve prior receipts. Reopen acceptance when source/runtime changes invalidate it. End each milestone with completed IDs, remaining IDs and exact blockers. Inspect visual captures individually. Presentation verification does not authorize infrastructure changes, external communications, meeting joins or destructive operations; use task-owned panes only.

Order: shared foundation and Salesforce regression baseline; AWS/Azure/GCloud/Platform/GitHub/GitLab; remaining native/service/host plugins; content workflows. For shipped content, inspect the content and execute a safe example workflow, qualifying instructions separately from executed results.

## Reproduce and update

```sh
PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd scripts/agent-validation-runtime
bun test tests/presentation-tracker.test.ts
# Validate actual registrations and all canonical rows:
bun test scripts/presentation-inventory.test.ts
# Preserve edits/receipts and add newly exposed surfaces:
TRACKER_ACTION=update bun test scripts/presentation-inventory.test.ts
```

Do not edit IDs, scope, acceptance or fingerprints by hand. Update status/evidence/receipt/delivery/blocker cells directly. New sources are reconciled by ID. Removed IDs stop generation until explicit retirement preserves their receipts. Generation refuses duplicate IDs. Inventory drift fails CI through the existing plugin test runner.

## Common verification matrix

Every exposed surface has eight independent gates. Required layout combinations: 40/76/120/153 columns × collapsed/expanded × xcsh-dark/xcsh-light × Unicode/ASCII/Nerd (48 combinations). Inspect each capture separately; record textual findings. Command surfaces require exact Bash and Zsh copy/execute checks with synthetic safe commands. Check monetary/count/unit formatting, literal long text, pagination, warnings and timer cleanup where exposed. Content workflows use shipped guidance and resulting shared output; unsupported capability requires a reason, not an exemption for the whole surface.

### A-capture

Capture and inspect current installed output; record exact invocation, resolved runtime/plugin and host. Keep raw captures private; publish findings only.

### A-defaults

Define useful default results, target/filter scope, units and consequential states. Preserve unknown evidence; distinguish supported, ready, provisional and unavailable.

### A-layout

Inspect readable tables and exact Bash/Zsh command copying at 40/76/120/153 columns, collapsed and expanded, both themes and Unicode/ASCII/Nerd presets. Include long text, pagination, counts, monetary grouping and units when exposed.

### A-outcomes

Check empty, unavailable, partial and failed outcomes independently with observable causes and next actions. An unavailable service is not an empty result.

### A-fidelity

Preserve zero, false, empty strings, literal text, warnings and complete safe evidence. Verify consequential data survives truncation/expansion; redact secrets without inventing values.

### A-expansion

Useful default results remain visible; expansion is needed only for long results or technical evidence. Check long text, pagination and scroll behavior.

### A-live

Switch theme/preset in the running session and verify updated output; where progress exists, check animation, cancellation, completion and timer cleanup. For content workflows, verify the resulting shared message surface.

### A-acceptance

Run focused regressions and installed acceptance using the shipped surface and a safe executed example. Attach separate test and installed/service receipts; mocked output cannot satisfy live acceptance.

## Plugin salesforce

Issue: <https://github.com/f5-sales-demo/marketplace/issues/1591>. Source version: `2.3.15`. Installed Mac: `2.3.14`; Ubuntu: `2.3.14`. Lifecycle: integrated.

Locate accepted 2.3.11 receipts; audit all six registered tools. Preserve command width, tables, currency grouping, monetary formatting and live spinner behavior through shared-renderer adoption. In this campaign, Salesforce service checks use the authorized corporate MDM MacBook. Ubuntu/NUC service access is unavailable by policy; source, immutable-artifact and unavailable-state checks remain separate.
